LESSON: JOSEPH INTERPRETS A DREAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy Bible
Topic 2.5: Joseph interprets a Dream

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Joseph interprets a Dream
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How was Joseph able to interpret dreams?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. retell the story of Joseph interpreting a dream
2. apply lessons learnt by depending on God’s wisdom
3. recognise that, ‘the fear of God is the beginning of wisdom.’

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: retell the story of Joseph interpreting a dream

• Listen/read the idea.

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: retell the story of Joseph interpreting a dream
• Model 2: apply lessons learnt by depending on God’s wisdom
• Model 3: recognise that, ‘the fear of God is the beginning of wisdom.’

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: retell the story of Joseph interpreting a dream
2. Practise: apply lessons learnt by depending on God’s wisdom
3. Practise: recognise that, ‘the fear of God is the beginning of wisdom.’

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Joseph interprets a Dream.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How was Joseph able to interpret dreams?
